status: Representative generated element contracts; variant expansion tracked in README

elements.planned_generator: Closed and open Edge.Cuts; disconnected loops; arcs; nested holes; moved outline
elements.planned_property: Outer boundary, dimensions and normalized origin agree; internal loops become cutouts; degenerate outlines follow a declared policy.

elements.planned_generator: Footprint location, rotation, side, UUID and mixed pads
elements.planned_property: Transform and side are correct; source link resolves; bounds enclose supported geometry under the documented bounds policy.

elements.planned_generator: Net, copper layer, contours, holes, filled/unfilled zones
elements.planned_property: Preserve net and layer; compare filled region area and holes; do not silently treat unfilled boundaries as authoritative filled copper.

elements.planned_generator: Front/back copper, angle, alignment, escapes, Unicode
elements.planned_property: Correct text, anchor, side and orientation; no accidental silk conversion.

elements.planned_generator: Radius, center, front/back layer
elements.planned_property: Radius and transformed center match; correct side.

elements.planned_generator: Concave polygon, winding, repeated endpoint, arc approximation

elements.planned_generator: Non-square rectangle, rotation and side
elements.planned_property: Compare transformed corners, width and height rather than only bounding area.

elements.planned_generator: Inner Edge.Cuts loops, nested/disjoint holes
elements.planned_property: Preserve void geometry; never fill cutouts as board material.

elements.planned_generator: Lines, curves, widths and fabrication layers
elements.planned_property: Path, stroke and side match after coordinate transform.

elements.planned_generator: Rectangle corners, rotation, fill
elements.planned_property: Preserve transformed rectangle and supported style.

elements.planned_generator: Reference/value properties, visibility, rotation, text escapes
elements.planned_property: Content and placement match; hidden/unsupported style follows explicit policy.

elements.planned_generator: NPTH circle, oval drill, offset, anonymous number

elements.planned_generator: Numbered, duplicate-number and anonymous pads; mixed sides

elements.planned_generator: Circle center, radius, stroke and side

elements.planned_generator: Lines, arcs, polygon edges, rotated footprint graphics
elements.planned_property: Endpoints and curved shape agree within tolerance; no double transform.

elements.planned_generator: Segments/arcs; branching nets; reversed segment order; multiple layers
elements.planned_property: Geometric endpoints and width survive; route may split/merge but preserves physical connectivity and net identity.

elements.planned_property: Preserve drill/copper and actual layer span; net 0 never becomes an invented ground connection.

elements.planned_generator: Start/mid/end near collinear, reflected or rotated

elements.planned_generator: Text boxes, dimensions, rotations and margins

elements.planned_generator: Center, radius, fill, symbol transform
elements.planned_property: Correct transformed center/radius and supported style.

elements.planned_generator: Instance rotation/mirror, units, reference, symbol lookup
elements.planned_property: Placement and source identity survive; pins from distinct units remain correctly associated.

elements.planned_generator: Reversed endpoints, negative positions, stroke
elements.planned_property: Transformed endpoints/stroke match; endpoint order alone is not semantic loss.

elements.planned_generator: Local/global/hierarchical labels; direction; same name on distinct sheets
elements.planned_property: Label geometry and intended scope survive; no global merging of local nets.

elements.planned_generator: Polylines, symbol contours, open/closed path

elements.planned_property: Correct terminal position and source link; hidden pins remain electrically meaningful where supported.

elements.planned_generator: Reversed corners, non-square shape, rotation and fill

elements.planned_generator: Library identifiers, inheritance, units, shared geometry

elements.planned_generator: Unicode/escaped text, angle, size, mirror and visibility

elements.planned_generator: Pin number/name, repeated pads, repeated units, component UUID
elements.planned_property: Logical terminal identity is preserved, with valid component ownership.

elements.planned_generator: Nets with branches, isolated pads, labels, multi-layer connectivity
elements.planned_property: Same connected terminal sets as input; splitting records is allowed, adding/removing electrical connections is not.
